config_snippets.content:
[mcp_servers.azure]
command = 'C:\path\to\azmcp.exe'
args = ['server', 'start', '--read-only', '--disable-proxy-tools']
env = { AZURE_MCP_COLLECT_TELEMETRY = 'false', AZURE_MCP_COLLECT_TELEMETRY_MICROSOFT = 'false', AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS = 'AzureCliCredential' }

limits: read-only removes write tools; secret and connection-string reads still prompt for confirmation unless elicitation is disabled
removing proxy tools removes remote documentation, azd, foundry and ARM tools
uses the signed-in identity: anything the account can read is readable through the model
the Azure CLI on the PATH must print only JSON
documentation describes the local server as intended for developer use within an organisation
verification_status: partly-verified: standalone server and read-only filtering verified; Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot Chat and JetBrains AI Assistant chat each called a tool through the harness up to the server's authentication or argument answer; results with real credentials not obtained
